brief:
An altercation between Arab Israeli lawmaker Ahmad Tibi and comedian Guy Hochman erupted in Israel's parliament, Al Jazeera English reported. The nature of the dispute and its cause were not immediately clear from available accounts.

The incident added to a pattern of confrontations in the Israeli legislature involving Arab Israeli representatives and other lawmakers over competing political positions and statements.
dek: An alleged altercation between Arab Israeli lawmaker Ahmad Tibi and comedian Guy Hochman sparks controversy.
title: Arab Israeli lawmaker Ahmad Tibi clashes with comedian in parliament
